title: Knowledge Universe Entry
description: A reviewed result in the database. The $defs shared with finding.schema.json must stay identical (enforced by tests/test_schema.py).

id.description: Assigned by tooling on merge. Do not set manually.

version.description: Schema version this entry conforms to.

subjects.description: What was tested on what. The join key for paradox detection; ids are filled by tools/normalize_entities.py during review.

title.description: One-line summary of what was tested and found (or not found).

observation.description: FREE TEXT. What was tested and what was (not) observed.

conditions.description: FREE TEXT. Parameters/conditions needed to interpret the result.

caveats.description: FREE TEXT. Self-assessed reasons the result might be an artifact.

alternatives.description: FREE TEXT. Suggested alternative approaches / future directions.

system.description: The experimental system. Fields optional but encouraged for filterability.

model.description: Cell line, strain, material, dataset, etc.

confidence.description: Makes the result interpretable. THE field most negative-results efforts omit.

positive_control.description: Was the assay ever shown to detect a TRUE positive? A null from an assay never validated to detect anything is nearly uninterpretable.

present.description: Was a positive control / known-effect comparator run?

worked.description: Did that positive control produce the expected signal?

detail.description: What the positive control was and its result.

powered.description: Was the experiment adequately powered to detect a meaningful effect? (Interventional special case of 'threats to validity addressed'.)

controls.description: Controls used that support trusting the result.

n.description: Replicates / sample size, free-form to accommodate any design.

detection_limit.description: The threshold below which an effect could not have been seen.

links.description: Typed edges to other entries or papers. Lineage relations (tests, motivated_by, revises) must form a DAG; tools/validate.py checks this across the database.

source.description: Where the result comes from. Omitted means contributed directly by a scientist.

related_positive.description: Known positive/contradicting results as free-form citations. Prefer links with relation 'contradicts' when the target has a PMID, DOI, or entry ID.

orcid.description: Strongly encouraged — ties credit to a persistent identifier.

relation.description: Lineage (form a DAG): tests, motivated_by, revises. Evidence (may run both ways): supports, challenges, replicates, contradicts.

target.description: An entry ID, PMID:<n>, PMC<n>, or DOI:10.<...>.

outcome.description: positive: an effect or relationship was observed; negative: it was looked for and not found; inconclusive: the experiment could not tell.

claim_type.description: effect_observed pairs with a positive outcome; the other four categorize negative and inconclusive results.

evidence_layer.description: The KIND of evidence, orthogonal to claim_type. A functional null and a binding positive are NOT contradictory.

curie.description: Compact identifier PREFIX:local_id. Prefixes follow PubTator3's namespaces: NCBIGene, NCBITaxon, MESH, cellosaurus, dbsnp. Add others only by agreement.

role.description: agent: what was applied or varied; target: what it was expected to act on; system: where it was tested; readout: what was measured.

label.description: The entity as named in the source.

conditions_structured.description: Optional structured conditions to enable comparability checks. Free-text conditions remain the fallback.

system.description: e.g. RRL, wheat-germ, HEK293T, 40 field sites

key_params.description: Domain-specific: buffer, [Mg2+], dose range, temperature, season...

passage_id.description: PubMed: PMID:<pmid>:ti (title) or PMID:<pmid>:ab (whole abstract). PMC: <PMCID>:ti, <PMCID>:ab:p<n> (abstract paragraph), or <PMCID>:s<path>:p<n> (body paragraph n of section path, e.g. s3.2; s0 holds paragraphs before the first section).
